newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National up as ScotAm decision looms.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National up as ScotAm decision looms.

text.p: Shares in British bank Abbey National Plc rose on Monday, rebounding from recent weakness as the decision on whether it had won the race for Scottish Amicable loomed.
The shares were four pence higher at 719 by 1000 GMT.
The Sunday Times newspaper said Abbey National was likely to be beaten by Prudential Corp Plc in the battle for ScotAm. But some dealers said this would boost Abbey National's share price.
"It's a brave man who bets on the outcome of the sale," one dealer said.

"But Abbey National shares have had a horrible time and it might be that some decided it had a big enough correction," he said. "But it might be that fears it will overpay for ScotAm are already in the price."
Prudential shares were down 15p at 543 after going ex-dividend.
